original_ai_output.title_zh: 贝宁-拉各斯高速公路发生三小时交通拥堵
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚贝宁-拉各斯高速公路Ovia桥至Okada路口路段周日发生严重交通拥堵，驾车者和通勤者被困超过三小时。拥堵中部分车辆出现机械故障，路段上的一起事故进一步加剧了交通状况。有司机将拥堵归咎于同行司机缺乏耐心及随意停车。

location.site: 贝宁-拉各斯高速公路Ovia桥至Okada路口路段
location.raw_text: between Ovia Bridge and Okada Junction on the Benin-Lagos Expressway

key_facts.fact: 贝宁-拉各斯高速公路Ovia桥至Okada路口路段发生交通拥堵
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: an early morning gridlock between Ovia Bridge and Okada Junction along the Lagos-Benin Expressway

key_facts.fact: 驾车者和通勤者被困超过三小时
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Motorists and commuters were stranded for more than three hours on Sunday

key_facts.fact: 拥堵中部分车辆出现机械故障，路段事故进一步加剧交通状况
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Some vehicles developed mechanical faults during the gridlock, while an accident along the route further compounded the traffic situation

key_facts.fact: 有司机将拥堵归咎于同行司机缺乏耐心和随意停车
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Some drivers blamed the gridlock on impatience and the indiscriminate parking of vehicles by colleagues
